research_rationale:
Executive Order 13823 (83 FR 4831, signed January 30, 2018, published February 2, 2018) was read in full from the held Federal Register text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_13823.txt, which is the registered official original for this order. Identity (number, date, title, signature date and FR Doc. 2018-02261) matches the registered source. The 18-clause inventory (Section 1(a)-(e), Section 2(a)-(e), Section 3(a)-(c), Section 4(a), (a)(i), (a)(ii), (b), (c)) covers the whole text with no omitted operative sentence. The order is not emergency-dependent: it rests on the President's constitutional and statutory authority, so no National Emergencies Act continuation is needed. Every clause is recorded as continuing on 2026-10-14 because no held instrument revokes, supersedes or amends any clause and the order's own text sets no end. The one deadline in the order, the 90-day recommendation in Section 2(d), is a deadline and not an end.
